line_evidence.observation: German selectable layout has dedicated Ü/Ö/Ä/ß keys at different physical positions from U/O/A/S.
rank() strips German accents to ASCII before resolving center coordinates; its 88-point endpoint filter operates on the wrong keys.
Physical Gesture ranked against actual arrangement through this decoder.
Regression examples cover QWERTY/QWERTZ, but not .german accented-key geometry.

findings.scenario: Using the German letter arrangement, swipe the physical Ü-B-E-R keys for the candidate 'über'.
findings.causal_chain: Geometry uses Ü's dedicated physical center, but normalizedSpelling('über') produces 'uber'. At width 440, German Ü and U centers differ by ~157 points, exceeding the 88-point first-key filter; the correct candidate is rejected before full ranking.
findings.root_owner: LatinSwipeDecoder.rank conflates normalized lexical spelling and physical keyboard geometry
findings.smallest_repair: Generate templates using actual available German character-key coordinates, with bounded fallback only when a key does not exist on the selected layout. Keep QWERTY/QWERTZ and UIKit single touch owner unchanged.
findings.regression_oracle: Pure Swift .german ideal-gesture ranking tests for über/Straße using literal Ü and ß key centers; QWERTY/QWERTZ existing smoke tests; physical iPhone German layout test after build authorization.
verification: Source and manual coordinate math only; no Swift runtime or iPhone executed.
Dedicated .german key layout absent #84, present #136; decoder ASCII normalization visible #84 and persists #232; exact introducing commit not established.

line_evidence.observation: List API and independent downloads resolve mutable /main instead of the same immutable source commit.
verifyFile always checks size but SHA-256 only when LFS oid is available and 64 characters; for other files no cryptographic digest is mandated.
User source validation accepts repository owner/name, not an immutable revision.

findings.scenario: Upstream model branch changes between catalog and file reads, or a matching-size file has no LFS oid.
findings.causal_chain: Unpinned revision plus optional per-file digest -> mixed-version artifacts or same-length mutated non-LFS bytes can pass current size checks.
findings.smallest_repair: Pin source tree and downloads to one commit revision, require verifiable object identity per selected file, stage/commit whole compatible bundle; never replace last usable copy on failure.
findings.regression_oracle: Mock changing remote branch and same-size corrupted no-LFS model; installer must reject, clean staged data and keep previous verified model.
verification: Source-level endpoint and SHA predicate verified; no actual malicious upstream behavior inferred and no corruption integration test run.
